title: Paper Ramp · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Ramp · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place a sheet and a small paper ball on a clear table. The lead folds the sheet into a ramp and releases the paper ball at the top. The ball travels down the ramp without being pushed after release. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: One sheet of paper and a small paper ball.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Ramp, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The ball travels down the ramp without being pushed after release.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The ball travels down the ramp without being pushed after release.

game.materials: One sheet of paper and a small paper ball
